# Butterneck

> Let them ask. You decide what goes live.

Butterneck is for product teams. People ask on a live copy of the product. The AI edits the project on a computer the team connects. A developer decides what goes live.

- Home: https://www.butterneck.com/
- Blog: https://www.butterneck.com/blog
- Share your local app with stakeholders without deploying it: https://www.butterneck.com/blog/share-local-app-without-deploying
- Human-in-the-loop AI coding: why Butterneck never merges: https://www.butterneck.com/blog/human-in-the-loop-ai-coding
- Pricing: https://www.butterneck.com/#pricing
- Privacy: https://www.butterneck.com/privacy
